scope: Independent synthetic review of causal five-input preparation and separately requested five-session labels against the frozen model specification.
review_checks: S and Q are copied as finite numeric values while original source fields and financial/industry qualification gates remain present; their upstream original-filing arithmetic is not reimplemented.
Independent Decimal arithmetic verifies unequal stock-versus-SPY five-session return, twenty-session activity median excluding current numerator, and exactly 200 SPY adjusted closes.
Guarded arrays verify that causal preparation accesses only p-5..p, p-20..p and p-199..p, never the decision-day entry or future labels.
Missing entry or any one of five future label closes preserves causal eligibility while the separate label result becomes unavailable.
Nonmonotonic synthetic future prices verify both target heads and the minimum of all five subsequent closes.
All original fields and all three synthetic qualified, excluded and unavailable events remain unchanged and present.
UTC-equivalent 09:00 ET decision timestamps, availability-floor equality and exact official early closes are accepted; naive, fractional-second and incorrect-offset decisions are unavailable.
limitations: Synthetic review does not establish the identity or completeness of the real 100-symbol market extraction or terminal financial corpus.
The adapter consumes frozen upstream S/Q and industry qualification; this review does not recalculate source financial facts.
Model fitting, calibration, persistent cash execution and economic outcomes are outside this review.
